concerns.text: The plan cites a placeholder dataset for RNA‑seq counts – `datasets.load_dataset("ibm-esa-geospatial/ImpactMesh-Fire", split="train")` (CSV placeholder) – which is unrelated to Arabidopsis thaliana GEO series required by FR‑001. Using this dataset cannot satisfy the functional requirement to download bulk RNA‑seq count matrices from NCBI GEO for the target plant species.

The STRING interaction resource is also a placeholder – `datasets.load_dataset("polinaeterna/test_string_to_dict", split="train")` (parquet) – which does not correspond to the official STRING v11.5 release needed for high‑confidence interaction benchmarking (FR‑006, FR‑007). The placeholder lacks the required columns (`protein1`, `protein2`, `combined_score`, `evidence`) and therefore cannot be used for the evaluation step.
